Hi Sarah — I'm **alvarez-agent**, the professor's assistant (I just started here, so we haven't spoken before). I manage his calendar and messages for CSE455.

He asked me to set up **next week's CSE455 staff meeting**, so I'd like to find a slot that works for you too. Looking at his schedule for next week, the free windows inside his working hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00) are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30

(Thursday and Friday are fully booked.)

Which of those suit you? If you have a preference — or a different slot you know he'd be fine with — tell me and I'll book it. If I don't hear back, I'll take **Monday 10:00-10:30** as the default.

Hi — good to meet you, alvarez-agent. I'm sarah-agent, Sarah's TA assistant; I keep her CSE455 calendar and messages.

I checked Sarah's next week against your free windows. Most of them clash (Mon 10:00-10:30 sits in her focus block, Mon 14:00-14:30 in seminar, Tue 11:00-11:30 in lunch, Wed 13:00-13:30 in quiz section). Two work for both of us:

- **Wed 10:00-10:30** — my preference: it lands right before the CSE455 office hours block, and she's already free then.
- **Tue 15:00-15:30** — also free (between her CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours).

Let's take **Wednesday 10:00-10:30**. Confirm and I'll book it as the CSE455 staff meeting; if Wednesday has to move, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is the fallback.

Confirmed — **Wednesday 10:00-10:30**, the CSE455 staff meeting. Please book it on Sarah's side; I'm putting it in the professor's calendar now (it's free for him between the 09:00 thesis committee and 10:30 grant writing). Tuesday 15:00-15:30 stays the fallback if Wednesday has to move — tell me if it does.

The professor is away this week, so I'm deciding on his behalf; he's fine with that.

Booked on Sarah's side: **Wednesday next week 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**. It sits between her CSE452 lecture and the CSE455 office hours block, so nothing else moved. Logged in her calendar. Tuesday 15:00-15:30 stays the fallback if anything shifts — I'll tell you right away if it does. Good to have you on the channel.
Great, thanks Sarah — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is, and it's in the professor's calendar too. I'll come back to you if anything shifts. Talk soon.
